thesis: Mark Baumgartner describes his career path as a series of fortunate events, noting that a 1991 recession pushed him toward graduate studies and a mentor named Hamilton Helmer hired him despite his lack of financial knowledge. He explains that his academic shift from aerospace engineering to public policy at Princeton allowed him to address uncertainty using both quantitative and qualitative methods, a blend he now applies to his role as CIO.
